title: Isox project
description: Configuration for an Isox project. Its root is the directory containing this file.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema.

name.description: Unique project name. Defaults to the containing directory name.

dependencies.description: Names of projects this project depends on. Dependency scheduling is not yet implemented.

commands.description: Commands available through isox <command> <target>, where target is the project name.

configurations.description: Named overrides merged over options. Nested objects and arrays are replaced.

defaultConfiguration.description: Configuration selected when no configuration is specified on the command line.
